facts.business: Raymond Realty Limited is a focused, pure-play real estate developer with a diversified residential and retail portfolio across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), leveraging owned land in Thane and an asset-light Joint Development Agreement (JDA) model in key micro-markets.
